reviews.summary: ICNT has a large scheduled vesting release on November 3, 2026—the signal date. Third-party trackers estimate roughly 19.5–19.7M ICNT (about 2.8% of supply), largely to investors/insiders; exact intraday timing conflicts across trackers.
materialRisks: Scheduled November 3 token unlock of roughly 19.5–19.7M ICNT (~2.8% of total supply), creating immediate supply/realization risk.
Most of the scheduled release is allocated to investor and insider/team-related cohorts, which are more directly relevant to potential sell-side supply.
Unlock-time data is inconsistent: one tracker lists 00:00 UTC while another lists the event as still upcoming, so the event may overlap the current session or have just occurred.

facts.fact: The audit snapshot was collected at 07:05:53 UTC on November 3, 2026; current UTC was 07:06 on the same date.
CoinGecko lists an upcoming November 3 ICNT unlock of 19.46M tokens, approximately 2.8% of total supply, including 6.4M for investors and 6.53M for the team.
Independent unlock trackers similarly estimate 19.68M ICNT, with about 76% directed to team/insiders and investors; they disagree on the precise intraday release time.
Official ICN documentation confirms that investor, team, development, and partner allocations are subject to staged unlock schedules.
